plan.reason: With only 24 of 100 evaluations used and 18 stagnant steps with zero recent improvement, the search is likely trapped in a local basin or under-exploring. Auto surrogate safely blends RBF and quadratic via held-out RMSE for a 5-D problem with limited data. current_to_best DE is robust for exploiting a surrogate landscape while still allowing diversity. Raising exploration to 0.45 and radius to 0.18 injects novelty-driven exploration to escape stagnation without abandoning local refinement (local_fraction 0.35). Moderate mutation/crossover and a 32-member population balance surrogate-search cost against per-generation true evaluations; 8 generations keep surrogate retraining affordable within the remaining 76-eval budget.
